_comment: The health check's knowledge-graph probes (specification 2.5 item 6.1). Each ASK must return true. Since S0.5 Pass B3 they read B28's model-content graphs (graphs.ts KG_GRAPHS; fixtures/kg/manifest.json says which file goes where) and check the Cafe's tenant types, axis declarations and reasoning module are in kg/domain, the correspondence records in kg/correspondence, and kg/metamodel empty. If the BMM gains or loses a class, update the count here deliberately; the count matches bmm/<Name> classes with a skos:definition (the pipeline's classes, as diff_kg counts them): in kg/domain the hand-authored axioms add the six concern-group classes and WeightedRelationship, which carry none, and the axis vocabulary (bmm/axis#AxisValue, S0.5 Pass B8) does not match the pattern. The graphs are named only by the tokens {{KG_DOMAIN}}, {{KG_CORRESPONDENCE}} and {{KG_METAMODEL}}, which the health check fills from graphs.ts (KG_GRAPHS), the one place graph names are spelled (S0.5 Pass B3 item 9).

probes.name: BMM metamodel has its 39 classes (kg/domain; generated classes, each with a skos:definition)
probes.ask: PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#> PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#> ASK { { SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?c) AS ?n) WHERE { GRAPH <{{KG_DOMAIN}}> { ?c a owl:Class ; skos:definition ?d . FILTER (REGEX(STR(?c), "^https://ontara.dev/ontology/bmm/[A-Za-z]+$")) } } } FILTER (?n = 39) }

probes.name: BMM class ServiceOffering sits under a BFO parent (kg/domain)
probes.ask: PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> ASK { GRAPH <{{KG_DOMAIN}}> { <https://ontara.dev/ontology/bmm/ServiceOffering> a owl:Class ; rdfs:subClassOf ?parent . FILTER (STRSTARTS(STR(?parent), "http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/")) } }

probes.name: Platform record module defines PlatformRecord (kg/domain)
probes.ask: PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#> ASK { GRAPH <{{KG_DOMAIN}}> { <https://ontara.dev/ontology/record/PlatformRecord> a owl:Class } }

probes.name: The Cafe's tenant types are present, grounded under a canonical runtime type (kg/domain)
probes.ask: PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> ASK { GRAPH <{{KG_DOMAIN}}> { <https://ontara.dev/ontology/tenant/cafe/Order> rdfs:subClassOf <https://ontara.dev/ontology/bmm/CanonicalRuntimeType> . <https://ontara.dev/ontology/tenant/cafe/OrderLine> rdfs:subClassOf <https://ontara.dev/ontology/bmm/CanonicalRuntimeType> } }

probes.name: The Cafe's three axis declarations name their generated predicates, with 12 permitted values (kg/domain)
probes.ask: PREFIX ontara-axis: <https://ontara.dev/ontology/bmm/axis#> ASK { { SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?p) AS ?np) (COUNT(DISTINCT ?v) AS ?nv) WHERE { GRAPH <{{KG_DOMAIN}}> { ?axis ontara-axis:valuePredicate ?p ; ontara-axis:hasValueSpace/ontara-axis:permitsValue ?v . FILTER (STRSTARTS(STR(?axis), "https://ontara.dev/data/cafe/reasoning/")) } } } FILTER (?np = 3 && ?nv = 12) }

probes.name: The Cafe's reasoning module keeps the precondition's HardConstraint typing (kg/domain)
The correspondence records hold the Cafe's tenant-type trace (kg/correspondence)
